user.title: Cartesia Sonic TTS
user.description: Enter your Cartesia API key. You can create one at [play.cartesia.ai/keys]({keys_url}).

data_description.api_key: The key is validated by loading your Cartesia voice list.

model.title: Model and language
model.description: The language list comes from the voices your Cartesia account can access.

data.streaming: Stream audio while it is generated

data_description.model: sonic-3.5 is the recommended default. Speed, emotion and volume are only applied on sonic-3.5 and sonic-3.
data_description.streaming: Lowers the delay before Assist starts speaking. Home Assistant transcodes the stream for the player, so this is safe to leave on; turn it off to fall back to one complete MP3 per request.

voice.title: Default voice
voice.description: These are the Cartesia voices for {language}. Each assistant can still pick its own voice later.

data_description.speed: 1.0 is the natural pace. Cartesia treats this as guidance, not an exact factor.
data_description.emotion: Optional. The first six entries are the ones Cartesia considers most reliable.
data_description.volume: 1.0 is the natural level. Values below 1.0 give a quieter, whisper-like delivery.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Cartesia
reauth_confirm.description: Your Cartesia API key was rejected. Enter a valid key to continue.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cartesia Sonic TTS
reconfigure.description: Confirm or replace the API key, then review model, language and voice.

abort.already_configured: Cartesia Sonic TTS is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Cartesia Sonic TTS entry is supported.

usage.title: Reliability and credits
usage.description: Cartesia fails requests once the monthly allowance is spent. A fallback engine keeps announcements working, and the credit sensors make the limit visible before you hit it.

data_description.fallback_engine: Used when Cartesia cannot be reached or is out of credits. Leave empty to raise an error instead.
data_description.monthly_allowance: Roughly 20,000 on the free tier. 1 credit is about 1 character. Set to 0 to hide the remaining-credits sensor.
data_description.admin_api_key: Only needed for exact usage figures from Cartesia. Create one at [play.cartesia.ai/keys/admin]({admin_keys_url}). Without it, consumption is estimated from what this integration sends.

quota_exhausted.title: Cartesia is out of credits
quota_exhausted.description: Cartesia rejected a speech request because the monthly allowance is spent. Speech stays unavailable until the allowance renews or the plan is upgraded. Check your consumption on the Cartesia usage page.
